opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers into BitConnect lending through a defined funding sequence: “step number one is fund your account with bitcoin and step number two is to buy your uh bit connect coins.” It then promises that, once coins are lent, viewers will “start learning daily profit automatically,” with returns of up to 40% per month. The referral slide shows participant levels and percentage bonuses, while the speaker ties income to recruitment by saying, “And you're making 0.01% from 100,000 people.” These are investment and recruitment propositions presented as a path to monthly earnings. The available evidence does not establish that the advertised returns were paid, that capital was recovered after the stated lockup period, or that the claims were independently verified.
